components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Coral-filled hero CTA with the flat-block edge; grows and lifts on hover, presses flat on active.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 14px 28px; border-radius: 10px; background: #f4805a; color: #1c1333; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.98rem; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: 5px 0 0 0 #110a21, 0 5px 0 0 #110a21; transition: box-shadow 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translate(-2px, -2px); box-shadow: 7px 0 0 0 #110a21, 0 7px 0 0 #110a21; } .ds-btn-primary:active, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { transform: translate(1px, 1px); box-shadow: 2px 0 0 0 #110a21, 0 2px 0 0 #110a21; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Transparent-at-rest secondary CTA; gains surface fill and a thin flat-block edge only on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 14px 20px; border-radius: 10px; color: #f3eef9; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.98rem; text-decoration: none; background: transparent; box-shadow: none; transition: box-shadow 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), background 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #2a1d4a; box-shadow: 3px 0 0 0 #110a21, 0 3px 0 0 #110a21; transform: translate(-1px, -1px); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: translate(1px, 1px); box-shadow: none; }

components.css: .ds-featured { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(200px, 0.85fr) minmax(0, 1.4fr); gap: 40px; align-items: stretch; background: #2a1d4a; border-radius: 28px; box-shadow: 8px 0 0 0 #110a21, 0 8px 0 0 #110a21; padding: 36px; font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; color: #f3eef9; } .ds-featured-metric { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; text-align: center; padding: 24px; border-radius: 14px; background: #1c1333; box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 0 rgba(17,10,33,0.55), inset 0 3px 0 0 rgba(17,10,33,0.55); } .ds-featured-metric-value { font-family: 'Unbounded', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 2.1rem; color: #f4805a; } .ds-featured-metric-label { font-size: 0.76rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #b9aed0; } .ds-featured-content { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; } .ds-featured-tag { display: inline-flex; align-self: flex-start; padding: 4px 14px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 0.76rem; font-weight: 700; color: #f4805a; background: rgba(244,128,90,0.16); } .ds-featured-title { font-family: 'Unbounded', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.5rem; } .ds-featured-summary { font-size: 1.15rem; color: #f3eef9; } .ds-featured-detail { font-size: 1.0625rem; color: #b9aed0; line-height: 1.65; }

components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 20px; padding: 18px 4px; border-bottom: 1px solid #33254f; font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; } .ds-row-main { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap; } .ds-row-tag { font-size: 0.76rem; font-weight: 700; color: #f4805a; } .ds-row-name { font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 600; font-family: 'Unbounded', sans-serif; color: #f3eef9; } .ds-row-summary { font-size: 1.0625rem; color: #b9aed0; } .ds-row-metric { font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 700; color: #b9aed0; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Skill Group
components.description: Flat-block-edged container for one grouped skill cluster; individual items are plain text, no per-item edge.
components.css: .ds-skill-group { padding: 22px; border-radius: 20px; background: #2a1d4a; box-shadow: 3px 0 0 0 #110a21, 0 3px 0 0 #110a21; font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; } .ds-skill-label { font-size: 0.76rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #4fd1ae; margin-bottom: 12px; display: block; } .ds-skill-items { list-style: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-skill-items li { font-size: 1.0625rem; color: #f3eef9; }

components.name: Disclosure Trigger
components.description: The signature press toggle with an authored two-line SVG icon (never literal +/- glyph text): flat-block edge at rest, presses flat and translates on expand.
components.html: Detail text.
components.css: .ds-disclosure { width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 50%; border: none; background: #2a1d4a; box-shadow: 3px 0 0 0 #110a21, 0 3px 0 0 #110a21; color: #b9aed0; cursor: pointer; transition: box-shadow 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-disclosure:hover { color: #f3eef9; transform: translate(-1px, -1px); box-shadow: 4px 0 0 0 #110a21, 0 4px 0 0 #110a21; } .ds-disclosure[aria-expanded='true'] { transform: translate(1px, 1px); box-shadow: 1px 0 0 0 #110a21, 0 1px 0 0 #110a21; } .ds-disclosure-panel { display: grid; grid-template-rows: 0fr; transition: grid-template-rows 360ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-disclosure-panel[data-open='true'] { grid-template-rows: 1fr; } .ds-disclosure-inner { overflow: hidden; } .ds-disclosure-text { font-size: 1.0625rem; color: #b9aed0; line-height: 1.65; padding-top: 14px; }

components.name: Contact Pill
components.description: Pill-shaped footer contact link; the nav CTA is the same pattern at a smaller size with inverted fill.
components.css: .ds-pill-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 9px 18px; border-radius: 999px; background: #2a1d4a; box-shadow: 3px 0 0 0 #110a21, 0 3px 0 0 #110a21; font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 700; color: #4fd1ae; text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-pill-link:hover { transform: translate(-1px, -1px); box-shadow: 4px 0 0 0 #110a21, 0 4px 0 0 #110a21; } .ds-pill-link:active, .ds-pill-link:focus-visible { transform: translate(1px, 1px); box-shadow: 1px 0 0 0 #110a21, 0 1px 0 0 #110a21; }

components.css: .ds-nav { position: sticky; top: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding: 14px 24px; background: #2a1d4a; box-shadow: 0 3px 0 0 #110a21; font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; } .ds-nav-mark { font-family: 'Unbounded', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; color: #f3eef9; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; gap: 24px; flex: 1; justify-content: center; } .ds-nav-links a { font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 600; color: #b9aed0; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; } .ds-nav-links a:hover { color: #f3eef9; } .ds-nav-links a[aria-current='true'] { color: #4fd1ae; border-color: #4fd1ae; } .ds-nav-cta { display: inline-flex; padding: 8px 18px; border-radius: 999px; background: #f4805a; box-shadow: 3px 0 0 0 #110a21, 0 3px 0 0 #110a21; font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 700; color: #1c1333; text-decoration: none; }

components.name: HeroScene (Three.js set-piece)
components.description: Live Three.js hero structure: a flat-shaded isometric spiral staircase alternating coral/jade treads with two landings, a floating gold beacon, and a counter-rotating closed-loop paradox satellite marked by an open gold keystone. Auto-rotates continuously (~52s/revolution), pauses under prefers-reduced-motion, off-screen, and on hidden tabs. Not representable as HTML/CSS; documented as narrative/behavior only.
components.css: .ds-hero-scene { width: 100%; height: 100%; min-height: 280px; border-radius: 28px; overflow: hidden; background: radial-gradient(circle at 60% 35%, #372a5c, #1c1333); }

components.name: IsometricPipeline (Three.js set-piece)
components.description: Live Three.js node/edge pipeline diagram reused for Lumen's branching pipeline and Kodely's linear RAG pipeline: flat-shaded boxy nodes, curved tube edges, a staggered emissive coral pulse per edge (2.2s loop), active only while the parent timeline entry is expanded. 2D labels are projected from the 3D camera each frame. Not representable as HTML/CSS; documented as narrative/behavior only.
components.css: .ds-pipeline { margin-top: 18px; padding: 18px; border-radius: 20px; background: #2a1d4a; box-shadow: 5px 0 0 0 #110a21, 0 5px 0 0 #110a21; max-width: 900px; } .ds-pipeline-canvas { width: 100%; min-height: 220px; }

narrative.overview: This is a full redesign, not a maturation of the prior neomorphic world. The dual-shadow soft-extrusion material, the #e0e5ec plane, and the Sora/Hanken Grotesk pairing are retired outright — kept only as historical evidence of what this is a portfolio for, never as authority over this world's material. The new world commits to a deep twilight ground carrying every surface, two live Three.js set-pieces (an isometric staircase-and-paradox-loop hero structure, and a second pipeline diagram reused across two Experience entries), and a 2D flat block material that simulates an isometric cube's shaded faces with hard, zero-blur offset color — never a soft shadow, never blur or glass. The dual-discipline thesis (ships ML into real production systems) is made spatially rather than stated: the hero's single Three.js structure interleaves coral (applied ML) and jade (systems) treads and landings around one spiral, under one fixed warm sun light with a cool violet fill — the same two-hue classification axis from PRODUCT.md, now expressed as geometry and light rather than as shadow-carved panels. The same flat-shaded material recurs in the second Three.js set-piece lower on the page, so the world reads as built once and reused, not decorated per section.
keyCharacteristics: A committed dark twilight ground (--bg: #1c1333) and two raised surface tiers (--surface, --surface-raised) carrying every panel, card, and pill — no light-neutral plane anywhere.

Two live Three.js set-pieces (hero structure, isometric pipeline diagrams) built from flat-shaded MeshStandardMaterial geometry, lit by one warm directional sun plus ambient and cool violet fill — no PBR gloss, no soft raster shadow look.

A 2D flat block material: paired hard-edged, zero-blur offset color on the bottom-right of every card, button, and pill, standing in for an isometric cube's two shaded side faces under one fixed upper-left light.
Two committed jewel accent channels (coral-terracotta for applied ML, jade-teal for systems engineering) plus one reserved warm-gold beacon accent confined to exactly one sitewide fact.
Unbounded (display) + Manrope (body) — a blocky architectural geometric sans paired with a clean humanist body sans, replacing the prior Sora/Hanken Grotesk pairing outright.
One continuous ambient motion grammar: slow, non-interactive auto-rotation (hero structure, paradox loop, pipeline pulse), with a prefers-reduced-motion fallback to a static frame throughout.

rules.name: The AA-Everywhere Rule
rules.body: Every text and accent role clears WCAG AA against --bg, re-verified against the new dark ground rather than inherited from the retired world's light-ground numbers — there is no standing accessibility exception for this world.

rules.name: The One Alert Rule
rules.body: Warm gold (#f2c14e) is reserved as a UI/text color for exactly one sitewide critical-emphasis fact — the Lumen real-time-throughput figure — carried forward from the retired world's same-named rule, re-grounded in the new hex value. It never colors a pill, a button, or a second fact.

rules.name: The Category Channel Rule
rules.body: Coral means applied ML, jade means systems engineering, sitewide, assigned by what each entry's own headline metric proves — carried forward unchanged from PRODUCT.md's classification axis.

rules.name: The Flat-Block Rule
rules.body: Every shape-bearing 2D surface is defined by the paired, zero-blur bottom-right offset material — never a blurred shadow, never a border standing in for shape, and never a light source other than fixed upper-left/warm-sun. Do not reintroduce blur or a soft dual-shadow extrusion anywhere in this world.

rules.name: The Flat-Shaded 3D Rule
rules.body: Both Three.js set-pieces use flatShading: true materials with low metalness and no PBR gloss — matte, faceted, painterly, not a glossy product-render look.

dos: Do carve every 2D shape-bearing surface with the Flat Block material's paired, zero-blur bottom-right offset — never a blurred shadow.
Do keep the 2D light source fixed upper-left (dark faces always bottom-right) and the 3D light rig's warm sun + ambient + cool fill consistent across both Three.js set-pieces.
Do confine warm gold (#f2c14e) as a text/UI color to the one Lumen-throughput fact, per the One Alert Rule.
Do keep every text/accent color at or above AA contrast against #1c1333.
Do use the authored two-line SVG PlusMinusIcon (never a literal +/- glyph) for any new expand/collapse control.
Do pause all continuous motion (hero rotation, paradox loop, pipeline pulse) under prefers-reduced-motion, off-screen, and when the tab is hidden.
donts: Don't reintroduce blur, glass, or the retired world's soft dual-shadow extrusion anywhere in this world — the two materials (Flat Block and flat-shaded Three.js) are this world's only depth vocabulary.

Don't add a section-heading kicker/eyebrow above any h2 — this system's shipped pattern is a plain .sectionSubtitle paragraph placed below the heading, with no small-caps label element preceding a heading anywhere in the build.
Don't extend the pipeline pulse's or paradox loop's continuous-loop motion to a new component without the same live process reasoning already established for the two existing set-pieces.
Don't add a per-project GitHub/demo link, tech-stack chip, or date to an Experience/Project entry beyond what PRODUCT.md's Evidence on Hand confirms.

Don't attempt a literal single-camera-angle Penrose illusion in a continuously auto-rotating scene — it only reads correctly for an instant per revolution; use a rotation-safe paradox motif instead, as the hero does.
